finding: Completed audits among active data center abatements
notes: Reported by The Nevada Independent. GOED audits standard, aviation and data center abatements at the two-year and five-year marks from contract signature.

finding: Approved abatement per promised permanent job (data centers)
notes: Compared with roughly $190,000 per job for the Tesla large investment award.

finding: GOED does not systematically track realized tax revenues or total economic activity against projections
notes: The projections published in board packets are not followed up with measured outcomes.

finding: Construction worker residency data not released
notes: NRS 360.754 requires that 50 percent or more of construction workers be Nevada residents, but the compliance data is not published.

finding: Local government sales and use tax revenue foregone across all abatement programs
notes: Over eight years, statewide, all programs. Not data center specific.
